absent: Numeric values of process-control option constants and error codes beyond the names visible in fragments.
Arch-specific helper implementations for alignment, floating point, endian, TSC, FP mode, vector lengths, speculation, PAC, tagged address, DEXCR, RISC-V, shadow stack and CFI.
Security hook decision logic beyond its pre-dispatch veto role.
Full semantics of delegated helpers for seccomp, memory map fields, TID address, MDWE, VMA, AUXV, syscall dispatch, scheduler core, futex hash and RSEQ slice.
Internals of memory accounting, load average, topology mapping and boot-time helpers used by sysinfo and getcpu.
Complete integer vector parsing grammar beyond tested single-value cases including multi-value, whitespace, overflow and permission handling.
Process-tree walk implementation and descendant-marker propagation details.
Timer namespace adjustment and KSM merge enable and disable effects beyond the locking shown.

findings.text: Process control entry examines a security hook outcome first, then dispatches a large option selector on the calling task. Recognized selectors adjust or report per-task or per-memory state and return a status code, while unrecognized selectors are traced as unknown and rejected as invalid.

CPU locality query reports the current processor identifier and its locality through optional user pointers, succeeding when absent pointers are skipped and failing with a memory fault if a supplied pointer cannot be written.

System summary entries share a common filler that snapshots uptime, load averages, thread population and memory plus swap accounting, then copies the result to user space with a fault error on copy failure; a compatibility variant narrows the same snapshot into smaller fields.
Unimplemented system call placeholder provides a generic handler that always reports functionality not implemented.
Conditional syscall helpers expose macros that bind a requested name to either its implementation or the unimplemented placeholder, including a compatibility-table variant.

Many selectors enforce strict trailing argument discipline: unused positions must be clear, otherwise the request is rejected as invalid without side effects. This pattern covers machine-check, speculation, pointer authentication, tagged address, I/O flusher, memory merge, shadow stack, timer restore and related controls.

Parent-death notification is stored only after signal validity passes; dumpability accepts only two defined levels; timing mode accepts only the statistical setting; task naming truncates user input to the fixed comm capacity with guaranteed termination and notifies the proc connector.

The routed tail handling transparent huge-page disable state maintains two memory-descriptor flags as mutually exclusive selections when disabling, and clears both when re-enabling, finishing by releasing the memory write lock and reporting success.

Enabling child-subreaper marks the shared signal state and then propagates a descendant marker through the process subtree; disabling only clears the mark without a walk, while querying copies the current mark to user space.

Timer slack query clamps large kernel values to the unsigned-long ceiling; update is ignored for real-time or deadline scheduling classes, restores a per-task default on nonpositive input, and otherwise stores the supplied value.

System summary rounds boot time up to whole seconds, incorporates namespace-adjusted boot time, captures load averages and thread count, then rescales all memory fields by a power of two when the combined total fits, normalizing the unit to one to preserve historical user-space expectations and avoiding overflow.

Compatibility summary detects totals that do not fit in narrow fields and then repeatedly doubles the memory unit up to page granularity while shifting every memory field down, before narrowing into the smaller structure and zero-filling padding.

Parent-death update holds the global task list in read mode across the store to coordinate with parent-exit paths and avoid a data race; memory-merge toggle acquires the target memory write lock interruptibly and always releases it; the huge-page tail releases the same write lock.

Compatibility summary layout uses narrowed counters for uptime, loads and all memory fields, a 16-bit thread count plus explicit padding, a unit field, and trailing reserved bytes sized to keep overall footprint stable for older user programs.

Machine-check kill policy forms a small state machine over two task flags: clear removes process scope, set establishes it and selects early versus late delivery, default clears both, and query maps the flag combination back to one of three reported modes.

Control-flow branch-pad control validates a single feature selector, applies the requested state through an architecture hook, and when the request combines lock without disable it performs a second architecture lock step; failures from the first step suppress the lock step.

Several paths copy between kernel and user addresses and must handle faults: name fetch and query, death-signal and subreaper queries, thread-ID address, auxiliary vector, shadow-stack and branch-pad queries, plus system summary and CPU locality outputs all report a fault instead of partial success when user memory is inaccessible.
Memory merge toggle can be interrupted while acquiring the write lock, returning an interrupted status without changing merge state.
Unimplemented calls report not-implemented; removed memory-protection-extension management selectors always report invalid; test direction markers use zero for read and one for write.

Integer vector control handler is specified by tests to succeed with zero transferred length and no data effect when the table data pointer is absent, when declared capacity is zero, when the caller length is zero for either direction, or when a read starts at a nonzero file position.

With a well-formed single-integer table bounded between zero and one hundred, reads render the stored value as decimal text with line termination and report its length, while writes consume the supplied decimal text, advance file position by consumed length, and update the stored integer including negative values.
Writing a decimal value one below the representable integer minimum is rejected as invalid, leaves the caller length unchanged at its entry maximum, and preserves the prior stored value.

Privilege-sensitive toggles add capability or exact-value gates: I/O flusher query and update require resource-control capability, no-new-privs update requires an exact one with all other arguments clear and query requires all clear, and several other controls delegate to dedicated helpers.
